Name: Kyuya's accessories pack
Author: Kyuya258369
Description:
[size=6]                            [b][color=#ff0000] 请不要二次上传到任何地方
                 更不要拿去倒卖盈利以及在任何地方付费购买
[/color][/b][/size][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]                                      Please do not re upload to any place or pay for purchase.[/b][/size][/color][size=3]

[color=#f1f1f1]A collection of my accessories creations.This way, you don't have to download individual packs.But it maybe will update slowly.[/color]

[b][color=#ff0000]This is a FS module, you need to go to Pierre to buy the hand mirror and get it through the hand mirror.If you have any questions about the FS module, please go to the fashion sense module page for reference.[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Need[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]SMAPI, Fashion sense[/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Install[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1.Download and install all required.[/size]
[size=3]2.Download the pack and unzip it.[/size]
[size=3]3.Put the folder in "Mods".[/size]

[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]Update Log[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=3]1.The layer order of some accessories has been adjusted to avoid confusion.
[/size][/color][size=3]2.Two new accessories are included. (Long veil N34 and butterfly veil N35).
[/size]
[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]Important[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]1.This pack fits into another mod of mine. [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7331]click here[/url]
[size=3][color=#f1f1f1]
2.You could choose to delete them as you like.(Open the "Stardew Valley\Mods\[FS]Kyuya's accessories\Accessories",and delete which you dislike.)[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#f1f1f1]
3. If you want to use wings, please try to select the first two accessories positions, otherwise the layer may be disordered.[/color]
[color=#f1f1f1]
4. [/color][/size][size=3][color=#f1f1f1]The hat will cover the accessories, which can not be solved. If you mind, try not to wear the hat when wearing the accessories, or convert     the hat into FS [/color][/size]accessories[size=3][color=#f1f1f1] file for use.（If many people need it, I will try to turn my FS hat into [/color][/size]accessories[size=3][color=#f1f1f1].）

5.The parameters of FS are a little complicated for me, so maybe some items have layer or position errors. If you encounter these                      problems,  please feed back the number of these items to me.

6.Facial makeup (eyebrows, monocular pupils, powder blusher, lipstick, and makeup) is just a mask affixed to the face, and will not change with the change of the character's expression, so sometimes the face will have strange expressions, which is unavoidable, unless the body file is directly changed.
7. You can edit this mod for your own use. But don't upload it anywhere again without my permission.[/color]
[color=#f1f1f1]
8. Please do not spend money on modules published by non authors for any reason.[/color][/size]
[size=3]
Thank you for using my module,have fun < 3~
[/size]-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[size=3]一个我创作的饰品的合集包，这样你就可以不用一个一个去下载单独文件了。但是这里会更新得很慢。

[/size][color=#ff0000][size=3][b]这是一个FS模组，你需要去皮埃尔那里购买手镜，然后通过手镜获取这些东西。如果你对FS模组的使用有任何疑问，请移步Fashion Sense的mod页面进行查阅。[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]需要[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]SMAPI， Fashion sense[/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]安装[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1.下载并安装好所有前置。[/size]
[size=3]2.下载文件并解压。[/size]
[size=3]3.将解压后的文件夹放入“Mods”[/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]更新日志[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1.调整了部分饰品图层顺序，使之不再错乱。[/size]
[size=3]2.新收录两个配饰。（长头纱N34和蝴蝶面纱N35）[/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]重要[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1.这个头发包适配我的另一个模组。[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7331]点击这里[/url]

2.你可以根据自己喜好删除头发。（打开  "Stardew Valley\Mods\[FS]Kyuya's accessories\Accessories"，然后根据清单删除。）

3.如果你要佩戴翅膀，那就尽量用前两个配饰槽位装备，不然会出现图层错乱。

4.帽子会覆盖在配饰上面，这是没办法解决的，如果介意那么佩戴配饰的时候尽量不要带帽子，或者自行将帽子转化为FS的饰品文件进行使  用。（如果有很多人需要，我会试着把我的帽子转化为FS配饰文件。）

5.FS的参数对我来说有亿点复杂，所以可能有些东西会出现图层错乱或者错位，如果遇到了，就把有问题的物品的编号反馈给我。

6.面部妆容（眉毛，单眼美瞳，腮红和口红还有妆面）只是一张相当于贴在脸上的面具，并不会随着人物表情改变而改变，所以有些时候面部 会出现很奇怪的表情，这是无法避免的，除非直接更改身体文件。

7.除了自己私下使用，用于其他用途的修改和上传需要我的授权。

8.不要倒卖，不要付费去购买非作者发布且无授权的文件。
[/size]
感谢你使用我的模组，玩得开心 < 3~
